name: app/bar-chart
title: BarChart
summary: A bar chart rendered on the server as plain HTML: columns over time or labelled rows, the exact figures in a real table under "Show the figures", following the theme through tokens.

props.name: caption
props.description: One sentence: what is counted, over what range.

props.name: data
props.type: { label: string; value: number; long?: string }[]
props.description: The points; `long` is the table's label.

props.name: layout
props.description: Columns along the bottom, or one labelled bar per row.

behaviour: The bars are aria-hidden; the figures table (with a total) is the accessible version.
No data or all zero: "Nothing to chart in this range."
At most ~8 axis labels, always the first and last.
Bar sizes are SVG geometry (a <rect>'s height or width in a 0–100 viewBox), never inline styles: a CSP needs no style-src-attr 'unsafe-inline'.

aria: Bars aria-hidden; the table has a caption.

theming.brandOverlay: Bars are `--primary`, so they wear the brand mineral; the layout is identical.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: Scales from 320px to 1920px without distorting text; the plot is 12rem tall, 14rem from sm.
contract:
contract
  slot is "bar-chart"
  summary "Show the figures" min_height 44
  when default shows h3 "Sign-ups"
  when empty shows p "Nothing to chart in this range."
  when rows shows th "Admin"
end

checks.say: Bars are hidden from screen readers.
Every value is in the table, with a total.
